scripts.clean: rimraf .turbo build dist frontend/dist marimo/_lsp marimo/_static packages/lsp/dist src-tauri/binaries src-tauri/target
scripts.setup: pnpm install && make fe && pnpm download:uv
scripts.setup:win: pnpm install && pnpm build:fe && pnpm build:lsp && pnpm download:uv
scripts.setup:uv: uv python install 3.12 && uv venv && uv pip install -e ".[dev]" && pnpm install && pnpm build:fe && pnpm build:lsp
scripts.build:fe: pnpm turbo build --filter @marimo-team/frontend && pnpm format packages/openapi/ && rimraf marimo/_static && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('marimo/_static', {recursive: true})" && node scripts/copy-frontend.js
scripts.build:lsp: pnpm turbo build --filter @marimo-team/lsp && rimraf marimo/_lsp && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('marimo/_lsp', {recursive: true})" && node scripts/copy-lsp.js
scripts.tauri:build: pnpm run setup && node src-tauri/prepare-resources.js && cargo tauri build
scripts.tauri:build:win: pnpm run setup:win && node src-tauri/prepare-resources.js && cargo tauri build
